---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

leader_data <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(career_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(career_hr)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |>
      select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(full_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast)) |>
  left_join(
    Batting |>
      group_by(playerID) |>
      summarise(first_year = min(yearID), last_year = max(yearID), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    season_span = paste(first_year, last_year, sep = "-"),
    steroid_era_active = first_year <= 2009 & last_year >= 1994,
    steroid_era_active = factor(
      steroid_era_active,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
      labels = c("Active in steroid era", "Not active in steroid era")
    ),
    full_name = fct_reorder(full_name, career_hr)
  )

ggplot(leader_data, aes(x = career_hr, y = full_name, fill = steroid_era_active)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active in steroid era" = "steelblue",
      "Not active in steroid era" = "firebrick"
    ),
    name = "Steroid-era overlap"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(leader_data$full_name))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 players by career home runs, by steroid-era overlap",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Barry Bonds

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

bonds <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  mutate(season = yearID) |>
  select(season, HR)

ggplot(bonds, aes(x = season, y = HR)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds: home runs by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
